knobs.note: timeout on each op a box_commands row asks for (backup_now, harness_sync, cli_update, fly_machine_*); rc 124 records the command as ok:false "timed out after <n>s". Keep it below the worker's box_commands_claim_ttl_s settings row (fallback 1800), or a running op is re-offered to another claimer. Read by bin/box-ops.sh.

the most box_commands rows one bin/box-ops.sh tick claims; the rest wait for the next minute. A value that is not a positive integer is refused with one ALERTS line and nothing is claimed. Read by bin/box-ops.sh.
